item.title: DLN Roundup: Downingtown East wrestlers nips Avon Grove
item.description: In high school wrestling action on Wednesday evening, Downingtown East nipped Ches-Mont rival Avon Grove 32-31. Karsten Hodge (285 pounds) got a pin in the final bout to give the Cougars (4-0 National Division, 10-1 overall) the win at East.

item.title: Trump threatens tariffs on any country selling oil to Cuba, a move that puts pressure on Mexico
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said her government had temporarily stopped oil shipments to Cuba.

item.title: Jury finds Wisconsin man guilty of forging threat against Trump to get witness deported
item.description: The jury found Demetric Scott guilty of identity theft and witness intimidation.

item.title: Cheerios, Pringles, Nutella among thousand of products recalled over rodent, bird waste
item.description: Thousands of products, including Cheerios, Pringles, Heinz Ketchup and Nutella, have been recalled in multiple states over possible contamination from rat and bird waste.

item.title: Cougars top Eagles to keep postseason hopes alive
item.description: Desperate basketball teams are dangerous teams. Thursday night at Bishop Shanahan, the Downingtown East boys’ basketball team was playing for its District 1 6A playoff lives. The Cougars entered the day ranked No. 28 in what will be a 24-team tournament.

item.title: BOYS BASKETBALL: Nico Vacchiano leads Wissahickon past Cheltenham
item.description: Nico Vacchiano scored 10 of his game-high 26 points in the fourth quarter to help Wissahickon rally to a win over Cheltenham.

item.title: Flyers find a bumpy landing with loss in Boston
item.description: Problems with their flight from Columbus Wednesday night meant the Flyers didn’t get to bed in Boston until after 4 o'clock Thursday morning. They played like it in a 6-3 loss to the Bruins.
